movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.description: Zach Cregger revamps survival horror into a terrifying, hilarious masterclass in tension.
movies.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.description: Brad Pitt and a combat dog in an emotional, brutal Alaskan survival showdown.
movies.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

movies.title: Primetime
movies.description: Robert Pattinson channels Chris Hansen in this viral, razor-sharp A24 media nightmare.
movies.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

movies.title: The Shadow's Edge
movies.description: Jackie Chan's best-reviewed action thriller in decades delivers blistering cat-and-mouse stunts.
movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.
production_companies: iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）

movies.title: Verity
movies.description: BookTok's most toxic thriller comes alive — wild, unhinged, and fueling nonstop online debate.
movies.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

movies.title: Other Mommy
movies.description: Jessica Chastain descends into psychological nightmare fuel in this terrifying fresh chiller.
movies.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

movies.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
movies.description: A stirring, epic historical drama capturing wartime resilience with commanding authority.
movies.overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.description: Daisy Edgar-Jones dazzles in this exquisitely modern, emotionally resonant period romance.
movies.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

movies.title: Forgotten Island
movies.description: DreamWorks delivers breathtaking visual wonder and hilarious, heartwarming family adventure.
movies.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

movies.title: The Dog Stars
movies.description: Ridley Scott and Jacob Elordi craft a hauntingly desolate post-apocalyptic odyssey.
movies.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

movies.title: A Story of Derry
movies.description: Pennywise lore expands in this bite-sized nightmare packed with pure dread.
movies.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

movies.title: The Second Act
movies.description: Quentin Dupieux serves up delightfully weird, fourth-wall-breaking comedy gold.
movies.overview: Florence wants to introduce David, the man she’s madly in love with, to her father Guillaume. But David isn’t attracted to Florence and wants to throw her into the arms of his friend Willy. The four characters meet in a restaurant in the middle of nowhere.

movies.title: The Awakening
movies.description: Gritty wartime horror colliding with supernatural suspense for maximum midnight thrills.
movies.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Tom Holland’s newest chapter brings massive multiverse stakes and unstoppable crowd-pleasing energy.
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.description: The movie fans fought to save is finally here — hysterical, inventive, and deeply satisfying.
movies.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

movies.title: Drive - The Pretenders
movies.description: The viral romance thriller that has BookTok obsessing over every steamy twist.
movies.overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

movies.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
movies.description: Fast-paced zombie carnage and unrelenting tension make this an addictive survival ride.
movies.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

movies.title: Collision Course
movies.description: A sharp Spanish crime thriller wound tight with unexpected, explosive betrayals.
movies.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

movies.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
movies.description: Sacha Baron Cohen resurrects iconic satire with chaotic, cringeworthy belly laughs.
movies.overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

movies.title: Tenzing
movies.description: Tom Hiddleston and Willem Dafoe scale breathtaking peaks in this majestic mountaineering triumph.
movies.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.description: Kidman and Bullock reunite for bewitching nostalgia, sisterhood, and irresistible autumnal magic.
movies.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

movies.title: Animals
movies.description: Ben Affleck directs a pulse-pounding kidnapping thriller layered with sharp moral complexity.
movies.overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

movies.title: Hope
movies.description: Na Hong-jin unleashes an ambitious, terrifying sci-fi mystery that grips your throat.
movies.overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

movies.title: Buddy
movies.description: A warped, laugh-out-loud creature comedy packed with unhinged midnight-movie creativity.
movies.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

movies.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
movies.description: Raw, harrowing survival drama showcasing human courage in the face of absolute disaster.
movies.overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

movies.title: By Any Means
movies.description: A gritty 1960s true-crime manhunt anchored by fierce, magnetic performances.
movies.overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

movies.title: The Room Next Door
movies.description: Julianne Moore and Tilda Swinton shine brightly in Almodóvar’s tender, bittersweet masterpiece.
movies.overview: Ingrid and Martha were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

movies.title: Masterplan
movies.description: Stanley Tucci leads a suave European heist thriller bursting with clever reversals.
movies.overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

movies.title: Sacrifice
movies.description: Anya Taylor-Joy and Chris Evans clash in Gavras's chaotic, satirical volcanic blast.
movies.overview: At a glitzy Greek island charity gala, a down-on-his-luck movie star lands the heroic role of a lifetime when a volcanic doomsday cult takes him hostage.

movies.title: Dolly
movies.description: Gory, fast-paced indie slasher fun tailor-made for blood-soaked late-night viewing.
movies.overview: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

movies.title: Love of Your Life
movies.description: Margaret Qualley brings infectious warmth and charm to this modern, bittersweet romance.
movies.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

movies.title: Runner
movies.description: Alan Ritchson brings pure brawn and banter to a relentless chase thriller.
movies.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: Matchbox the Movie
movies.description: High-octane vehicular mayhem and John Cena’s charisma make this total popcorn escapism.
movies.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

movies.title: Doing Life
movies.description: Tyler Perry delivers high-stakes emotional melodrama that hits squarely in the heart.
movies.overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.description: The Further opens again for spooky jump scares that horror junkies crave.
movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

movies.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movies.description: Vertigo-inducing height frights and white-knuckle survival return with doubled stakes.
movies.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.description: Adam Wingard unleashes pure b-movie carnage with adrenalized martial arts thrills.
movies.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movies.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movies.description: Jane Schoenbrun deconstructs slasher nostalgia into an unforgettable, atmospheric dreamscape.
movies.overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

movies.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
movies.description: Matthew McConaughey oozes Southern gothic menace in this magnetic, slow-burn crime tale.
movies.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

movies.title: Tony
movies.description: Dominic Sessa is mesmerizing in Matt Johnson’s quirky, surprisingly poignant character piece.
movies.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.description: David Robert Mitchell crafts an eerie, hypnotic mystery that keeps you guessing endlessly.
movies.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.description: Lili Reinhart brings the viral fake-dating rom-com sensation to life with sparkling charm.
movies.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.description: Paul Greengrass directs Andrew Garfield through intense historical rebellion and chaotic fervor.
movies.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

movies.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
movies.description: Whimsical nostalgic family enchantment loaded with fairy-tale magic and colorful oddities.
movies.overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

movies.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
movies.description: Dinosaur thrills and puppy rescues collide in an irresistible crowd-pleaser for youngsters.
movies.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

movies.title: UNABOMBER
movies.description: Russell Crowe is deeply unsettling in this brooding, methodical investigation of terror.
movies.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

movies.title: One Last Shot
movies.description: Scott Adkins delivers bone-crunching, expertly choreographed martial arts fights without compromise.
movies.overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

movies.title: You+Me - Against the World
movies.description: A passionate French teen romance bursting with rebellious angst and youthful melodrama.
movies.overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

movies.title: Finding Emily
movies.description: A breezy, sunny British rom-com full of genuine laughs and romantic confusion.
movies.overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

movies.title: Drawn Together
movies.description: Ester Expósito smolders in a sleek psychological thriller dripping with romantic betrayal.
movies.overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

movies.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
movies.description: The beloved Parisian talent agents reunite for dizzying backstage chaos and show-biz wit.
movies.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.description: Jason Statham does what he does best — kicking serious tail aboard a hostile ship.
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: One Night Only
movies.description: Witty romantic chemistry and snappy dialogue keep this charming city escapade humming.
movies.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.description: Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh trade snappy barbs amidst wild mid-air espionage chaos.
movies.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

movies.title: Fuze
movies.description: Aaron Taylor-Johnson anchors an explosive London bomb-disposal heist ticking down under pressure.
movies.overview: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

movies.title: I Want Your Sex
movies.description: Gregg Araki returns with raunchy, neon-soaked transgressive comedy and seductive thrills.
movies.overview: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

movies.title: The Whisper Man
movies.description: Robert De Niro investigates chilling generational serial-killer dread in a frosty mystery.
movies.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

movies.title: The Secret Woman
movies.description: Claes Bang anchors an intricate Nordic noir laced with deadly secrets and betrayal.
movies.overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

movies.title: Barreda
movies.description: A grim, compelling Argentine true-crime study exploring a notorious real-life killer.
movies.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

movies.title: The Last Sunrise
movies.description: Sun-drenched coming-of-age romance filled with tears, sweeping views, and passionate choices.
movies.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
